annotations.title: Verify a committed call by hash

description: Verify a committed call by hash: returns the ledger record and whether its hash recomputes from the fields. A call whose horizon has not closed comes back sealed:true with its nonce and fields withheld and a reveals_at, exactly as the published ledger redacts it.

hash.description: the call's sha256 as 64 hex chars, as commit_call returned it; case does not matter
